subject.title: fix(doctor): skip groupAllowFrom migration for schemaless external channels

question: Should OpenClaw core doctor fail closed and skip groupAllowFrom writes when it cannot see a channel plugin schema, or should external plugins get an explicit opt-in migration contract first?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and addresses a real upgrade regression, but only maintainers can decide the compatibility boundary for core doctor repairs that touch external plugin-owned config.

options.title: Land Schema-Verified Guard
options.body: Merge the narrow fail-closed guard once normal gates pass, leaving schemaless external channel config untouched by core doctor.

options.title: Add External Opt-In Contract
options.body: Pause this fix and design a plugin doctor or schema capability so external channels can opt into this migration safely.

options.title: Supersede With Broader Protection
options.body: Close or supersede this PR only if broader config-protection work proves the same email/RCS regression behavior and coverage.

recommendation.title: Land Schema-Verified Guard
recommendation.body: Merge the narrow fail-closed guard once normal gates pass, leaving schemaless external channel config untouched by core doctor.

likelyOwner.reason: This account introduced and merged the fallback migration being repaired, so it is the strongest routing signal for the compatibility-boundary choice.
